method: U01-F01 per-run descriptive memory and frame analysis; run comparability is documented separately
limitations: No automatic pass/leak threshold; compare warm-up, segment floors/ranges and tail trends.
Working set is residency, private bytes are committed private memory, Unity allocated memory is usage in Unity allocator pools; these are not equivalent or additive.
5-second samples do not capture all transient peaks. Result peakWorkingBytes is an OS process-lifetime high-water mark, not the sampled maximum.
Result finalWorkingBytes is the last 5-second sample, not a measurement after model destruction.
Evidence sampling starts after model/UI initialization; model destruction occurs at exit, after sampling stops.
Fixed 15-second blocks are time bins, not exact logged greeting cycles. Screenshot timestamps are filesystem metadata only.
Run comparisons cannot isolate OS cache/order effects or prove absence of every leak; no significance test or long-term extrapolation is asserted.

player_result.scope: Real Windows Player, fixture HTTP/WAV, Unity output callback sampling. No cloud/ASR or OS loopback latency claim.
